en.name: Pickled ginger
en.summary: Pickled ginger covers the pale sweet-vinegar gari served with sushi and the red, salty beni shoga shredded over noodles and rice. An unopened shelf-stable jar keeps about a year in the cupboard; once opened it goes in the fridge, where 1–3 months is the working range.
en.pantry: Unopened shelf-stable jars keep about a year in a cool dark cupboard from the day you buy them. Refrigerated packs from the chiller cabinet do not belong here at all — if you bought it cold, keep it cold, whatever the jar looks like. That one-year figure is borrowed from pickles generally rather than published for ginger; a second published chart is tighter still, giving opened jars only one to two months, so the low end of any range is the safer read for quality.
en.fridge: Refrigerate once opened, with the ginger kept under its liquid, lid on, at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and treat 1–3 months as the working range. Gari is a vinegar-and-sugar pickle, so acidity is what is doing the work: the level of acidity in a pickled product matters as much to its safety as to its taste, and pickling recipes assume vinegar at 5 percent acidity. Homemade gari made with a weak rice vinegar is therefore not really a preserve — keep it cold and eat it within a couple of weeks. Beni shoga, sitting in its salty plum brine, keeps better than sweet gari does.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for pickled ginger and no reason to freeze it. It is already a preserve, and a refrigerated jar lasts months; freezing would only turn the crisp slices limp, which is the one quality gari is bought for. If you have too much, the more useful move is to use the pickling liquid — it makes an excellent dressing base — rather than to try to extend the ginger itself.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould of any colour on the surface or around the rim
Cloudy, ropy or slimy liquid where it should be clear
A lid that has domed, or fizzing when the jar is opened
An off or fermented smell, or slices that have gone soft and mushy
tips: Always use clean dry chopsticks or a fork; water and crumbs are what ruin a jar.
Keep the slices pushed down under the liquid.
Do not trust a bright pink colour as a freshness sign — commercial gari is often dyed.
Save the pickling liquid for dressings and marinades instead of pouring it away.

faq.q: How long does pickled ginger last after opening?
faq.a: 1–3 months refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept under its liquid. That range is borrowed from pickles; a tighter published chart gives opened jars only one to two months.
Unopened shelf-stable jars keep about a year in the cupboard. Anything bought from the chiller cabinet, and every jar once opened, belongs in the fridge.
There is no timeline and no reason to. It is already preserved, and freezing turns the crisp slices limp.

faq.q: Is homemade gari as safe as shop-bought?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Acidity is what makes a vinegar pickle safe, and recipes assume vinegar at 5 percent acidity. Gari made with a weak rice vinegar should be treated as a fridge item and eaten within a couple of weeks.

zh.name: 醃薑
zh.summary: 醃薑包含配壽司吃的淡色甜醋薑片（gari），以及切絲撒在麵食和丼飯上的紅色鹹薑（紅生姜）。未開封的常溫罐裝在櫥櫃約可放一年；開封後改冷藏，1～3 個月是工作範圍。
zh.pantry: 未開封的常溫罐裝，從購買日起放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃約一年。但冷藏櫃買回來的包裝品完全不適用這一項——冷藏買的就要冷藏保存，不管罐子看起來如何。這個一年的數字是比照醃漬類整體而來，並非針對薑公布；另一份公布的表格更保守，開封後的罐裝只給一到兩個月，所以以品質而言，任何範圍的下限都是比較安全的讀法。
zh.fridge: 開封後請冷藏，薑片壓在醃汁底下、蓋好蓋子，維持 4°C 以下，並以 1～3 個月為工作範圍。甘醋薑是醋加糖的醃漬品，真正在發揮作用的是酸度：醃漬食品的酸度對安全性的重要性，和它對風味的重要性一樣高，而醃漬配方的前提是使用 5% 酸度的醋。因此，用酸度偏低的米醋自製的甘醋薑，其實稱不上是保存品——請冷藏並在兩週內吃完。至於泡在鹹梅醋裡的紅生姜，保存表現比甜的甘醋薑好。
zh.freezer: 醃薑沒有冷凍保存期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。它本身就是保存品，冷藏一罐可以放好幾個月；冷凍只會讓爽脆的薑片變軟，而那正是買甘醋薑唯一在意的口感。真的太多的話，更實用的做法是把醃汁利用起來——那是很好的沙拉醬基底——而不是想辦法延長薑片本身。
spoilage: 表面或瓶口出現任何顏色的毛狀黴
原本應該清澈的醃汁變混濁、牽絲或黏滑
瓶蓋鼓起，或打開時冒氣泡
有異味或發酵味，或薑片變得軟爛
tips: 一定要用乾淨的乾筷子或叉子；水和碎屑就是一罐醃薑的死因。
每次取完把薑片壓回醃汁底下。
不要用「顏色鮮不鮮」判斷新鮮度——市售甘醋薑常有染色。
醃汁別倒掉，拿來調沙拉醬或做醃肉汁都很好。

faq.q: 醃薑開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏、壓在醃汁底下，1～3 個月。這個範圍是比照醃漬類而來；另一份較保守的公布資料，開封後的罐裝只給一到兩個月。
未開封的常溫罐裝放櫥櫃約一年。但冷藏櫃買的，以及任何已經開封的，都該放冰箱。
沒有對應的期限，也沒有理由。它本身就是保存品，而冷凍會讓爽脆的薑片變軟。

faq.q: 自製甘醋薑和市售的一樣安全嗎？
faq.a: 不一定。讓醋漬品安全的是酸度，而配方的前提是使用 5% 酸度的醋。用酸度偏低的米醋做的甘醋薑，應該當成冷藏食品並在兩週內吃完。
